text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَا مِنْهَآ ءَايَةًۢ بَيِّنَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ

words.gloss_range: connective opening that links the ayah to the prior punishment report and helps launch the certified aftermath clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens by linking 29:35 to the prior punishment report. Its main payoff is continuity and resumption: the ayah does not begin as an isolated claim but as the aftermath in which destruction becomes evidence. As part of the wa-la-qad launch it also helps front-load solemn certainty, though the following particles carry the explicit certification. The single-letter form makes relation the first audible move, and the possible circumstantial pressure keeps the left sign within the event's aftermath rather than as an accidental later reminder.

topics.headline: opening connector carries aftermath forward
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is not detached from the punishment report; it turns the prior destruction into an evidentiary aftermath.
topics.reason: The aligned particle is a conjunction at the start of the main clause, and the CRITICAL rows coherently read it as both continuation and resumption from 29:34.

topics.headline: connector joins the la-qad certainty cluster
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connector helps front-load solemn assertion, while the explicit certifying force is carried by the following la-qad particles.
topics.reason: The implied-oath claim is plausible only as part of the opening wa-la-qad frame; the particle by itself remains a connector rather than an independent oath word.

topics.headline: connection can make the remnant concurrent with aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is not made to feel accidental after the event; it belongs within the destruction aftermath itself.
topics.reason: A circumstantial reading is possible as semantic pressure, but local grammar still supports the broader connective and resumptive function.

topics.headline: single-letter form makes relation first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with dependency before lexical content, so relation is the first audible move.
topics.reason: The surface is a bound single-letter particle, and the row draws only a form-level payoff from that visible shape.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle in the la-qad frame; assertion marker rather than a governing preposition
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the emphatic lām of the la-qad frame, not the preposition that governs a noun. Before the verb appears, it tells the reader how the claim is to be received: the leaving of the sign is certified, resistant to denial, and joined to the following completion marker. Its bound form makes emphasis and completion work as one launch unit before the action is named.

topics.headline: emphatic lām certifies the coming event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is introduced under assertion pressure before the verb names the act.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this token as the emphatic lām prefixed to qad, not the genitive-governing preposition; the CRITICAL rows align around that certified-news function.

topics.headline: written fusion binds emphasis to completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis and completion arrive as one prefatory cluster rather than as separable commentary.
topics.reason: The particle is bound to the following qad in the la-qad unit, so its local force is inseparable from the certification frame.

topics.headline: certainty is heard before the action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah tells how firm the claim is before revealing what was done.
topics.reason: The emphatic particle precedes the perfect verb in the main verbal assertion, matching the CRITICAL information-order claim.

words.gloss_range: certification particle before a perfect verb, marking completed factuality rather than possibility
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) before the perfect verb marks completed certainty. The sign left behind is not introduced as possibility or memory but as a verified completed act. Because the particle remains separate from the verb, certainty frames the whole verbal event from outside. It also helps shape the ayah's architecture: certified aftermath leads to a clear sign and then to the reasoning audience.

topics.headline: qad before perfect marks completed fact
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the leaving of the sign is framed as verified completion, not possibility or expectation.
topics.reason: The particle stands before a perfect verb, so the local value is taḥqīq-like certification of a completed act.

topics.headline: certainty frames the verb phrase from outside
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that completion is not hidden inside the verb; an independent pre-verbal marker frames the whole act.
topics.reason: The row claims follow the visible particle boundary and the la-qad stack before the verb.

topics.headline: opening certainty leads toward sign and audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah moving from certified aftermath to evidence and then to the audience able to read it.
topics.reason: The structural rows match the clause sequence: emphatic opening, completed act, evidence phrase, then reasoning recipients.

words.gloss_range: completed first-person plural leaving behind; locally selected as deliberate preservation of a sign, not neglect or omission
words.root_gloss_range: root range around leaving, forsaking, abandoning, leaving behind, and bequeathing; the local object sign narrows it to leaving behind as evidence
words.prose: {{ar:تَرَكْنَا}} ({{tr:taraknā}}) names the completed leaving as a divine first-person plural act. Its grammar governs both a source phrase and a direct object, so the reader first locates the destroyed source and then meets the sign left from it. The root {{ar:ت ر ك}} ({{tr:t-r-k}}) can carry abandonment, forsaking, leaving behind, or bequeathing, but the local object sign narrows the verb toward deliberate evidentiary leaving rather than omission or neglect. The active Form I surface keeps agency direct, while the punishment-remnant parallels, especially 51:37 and 54:15, make the ruins function as testimony rather than residue. Its compressed onset after the certifying particle and clipped t-r-k texture make the perfect verb land as the boundary hinge from announced punishment to established proof.

topics.headline: perfect plural verb names completed agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the remnant is not accidental survival; the verb assigns the completed leaving to the divine speaker.
topics.reason: The aligned verb is perfect first-person plural with subject agreement and an explicit object frame.

topics.headline: verb governs source and sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that origin is fixed before the sign is named: the evidence comes from the destroyed place and is what was left.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the sign as direct object and the min phrase as a source complement of the verb.

topics.headline: leaving behind becomes deliberate testimony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the double edge of the verb: the place is abandoned in judgment, yet something is preserved as readable evidence.
topics.reason: The broad root includes abandonment and neglect, but the local object is a sign, which selects leaving-behind as evidence and blocks mere omission.

topics.headline: active Form I keeps agency direct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wording uses a finite active act, not passive residue, delegated causation, or an agent-title.
topics.reason: The local form is PV Form I active; supplied alternative family forms clarify contrast without replacing the parse.

topics.headline: leaving a sign belongs to a punishment-remnant pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this remnant participates in a recognizable evidence-after-destruction pattern also visible in 51:37 and 54:15.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence and echo rows tie this local verb-object frame to supplied punishment-remnant parallels without overriding the local syntax.

topics.headline: leaving points toward clarity and audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the act of leaving already aims at proof: the remnant will be clarified and addressed to a reasoning audience.
topics.reason: The local object, adjective, and audience phrase license the evidence-field links, including the 29:38 comparison supplied by the row.

topics.headline: hard verbal landing marks certified aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the boundary jump from announced punishment to established proof, with the perfect verb landing as the hinge.
topics.reason: The sound and boundary claims stay tied to the visible word shape and the cross-ayah transition from 29:34 to 29:35.

words.gloss_range: source or partitive phrase with attached feminine suffix; locally resumes the destroyed settlement while allowing remnant force
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهَا}} ({{tr:minhā}}) is the hinge between the leaving-act and the sign. The phrase can be heard as source and partitive at once: the sign comes from the destroyed place and is of its remains. Its feminine suffix is locally narrowed by the cross-reference to the destroyed settlement, even though the event of punishment still presses metonymically through the place. Because the preposition and suffix are fused in one word, sourcehood and referent recovery happen before the object is finally named.

topics.headline: from it means source and remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence is both from the destroyed place and of its remains, not a lesson floating free of locality.
topics.reason: The preposition is governed as the verb source complement, and the CRITICAL source, partitive, and explanatory readings are locally compatible.

topics.headline: feminine suffix routes back to the destroyed settlement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a single suffix carries the prior settlement into this ayah, while possible broader feminine associations are narrowed by context.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence strongly resolves the suffix to the destroyed town from the prior context, so punishment or story readings survive only as metonymic pressure.

topics.headline: the place-pronoun carries the catastrophe
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the locality stands for the event that destroyed it, making the two ayahs one evidentiary sequence.
topics.reason: The feminine locality-pronoun pattern is supported by the cross-reference and by supplied parallels 15:76 and 51:37.

topics.headline: preposition and suffix fuse the source hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sourcehood and referent recovery are compressed into one word before the object appears.
topics.reason: The surface combines preposition and bound 3fs suffix, and the phrase intervenes before the object sign.

topics.headline: contrast rows belong to the sign phrase rather than this word
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The contrast concerns nearby sign and audience vocabulary rather than the local source-pronoun payoff.
topics.reason: These rows are meaningful for the ayah, but as word-level topics they concern the sign phrase, audience formula, or later plural evidence rather than the source-pronoun itself.

words.gloss_range: indefinite accusative sign as the object left behind; a singular evidence-unit rather than a pre-identified item
words.root_gloss_range: range around sign, proof, portent, marker, and verse; the local object phrase selects a material and epistemic sign left from the destroyed place
words.prose: {{ar:آيَةً}} ({{tr:āyatan}}) is the accusative object left behind and the head of the following clarity adjective. Its indefinite singular form classifies the remnant as a sign without pre-identifying one monument, compressing many possible traces into one evidence-unit. The root {{ar:أ ي ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-y-y}}) supports sign, proof, portent, and verse language, while the disputed return-point pressure only thickens the image: the local noun remains a sign that points beyond itself and gives reasoning somewhere to return. Its nominal profile matters: signhood is presented as an object-state to encounter, not as someone performing an act of signing. In the ayah's chain, signhood is built for rational processing, not mere viewing, and the same evidence vocabulary threads through Surah 29 at 29:24, 29:44, 29:47, and 29:49 while also echoing punishment-remnant passages such as 51:37 and 54:15.

topics.headline: accusative sign is the object and adjective head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is the thing deliberately left, and its clarity is grammatically locked onto it.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence forces the noun as direct object of the verb and the following adjective as its qualifier.

topics.headline: one indefinite sign classifies the remnant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah classifies the remnant as a sign without pre-identifying it, concentrating many ruins into one readable unit.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative indefinite singular, and the CRITICAL rows draw a coherent categorical-singular payoff from that form.

topics.headline: sign, proof, verse, and return-point pressure converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the remnant points beyond itself as proof and also becomes a point to which reflection returns, while the local surface remains the sign noun.
topics.reason: The derivational dispute and broader sign range are valid pressures, but they do not change the local noun into a different word or sense.

topics.headline: signhood is presented as an object-state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that signhood is something encountered as an object, not an action someone performs in the verse.
topics.reason: The supplied occurrence and form evidence keeps the local item nominal, matching the object role.

topics.headline: the sign is built for rational recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that signhood, clarity, and reasoning are not separate decorations; the sign is constructed to be processed.
topics.reason: The local phrase places the sign beside its clarity and later reasoning audience, and the supplied co-occurrences support that evidence field.

topics.headline: punishment material becomes readable evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah compressing divine act, remnant, clarity, and audience into one evidence chain tied to Surah 29 and punishment-remnant echoes.
topics.reason: The rows describe local sequence, same-surah evidence vocabulary at 29:24, 29:44, 29:47, and 29:49, and supplied t-r-k parallels such as 51:37 and 54:15.

words.gloss_range: accusative feminine adjective qualifying the sign as manifest and evidentiary, not merely visually obvious
words.root_gloss_range: range around separation, distinctness, clarification, manifestation, and proof; the local adjective selects clear evidentiary force
words.prose: {{ar:بَيِّنَةً}} ({{tr:bayyinatan}}) is not a loose flourish after the sign. Agreement in case, gender, and number binds it to the object phrase, so clarity belongs to the sign itself. The root {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) ranges through separation, manifestation, explanation, and proof; here the sign selects decisive evidentiary clarity rather than mere brightness. The doubled form and sound intensify that clarity, and the movement toward reasoning recipients makes the clear sign something checkable by reason. The chosen bayyina form presents the sign as proof in itself rather than primarily as an active clarifier, singularizing a wider clear-sign formula into one public remnant and tying the opening certainty back to clarity and reasoning.

topics.headline: clarity is grammatically tied to the sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarity is not a separate comment; it travels with the sign as its case-bound quality.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the sign in accusative feminine singular form and is licensed as its qualifier.

topics.headline: indefinite adjective makes a categorical clear sign
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase presents a clear sign as a category, with sign and clarity arriving as a paired cadence.
topics.reason: The adjective mirrors the indefinite object and follows it, producing the paired evidence phrase.

topics.headline: clear means manifest proof, not mere brightness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is marked as legible proof, not just something plainly visible.
topics.reason: The root range includes clarity and manifestation, but attachment to the sign selects evidentiary clarity as the local force.

topics.headline: form and gemination intensify clarity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word shape itself presses clarity as emphatic and intrinsic to the sign.
topics.reason: The doubled internal sound and supplied form-family observations support an intensifying payoff without changing the adjective role.

topics.headline: clear proof calls for rational verification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that clarity is oriented toward a reasoning audience; the sign is clear enough to be checked, not merely admired.
topics.reason: The local phrase moves from clear sign to audience who reason, and the supplied b-y-n with reasoning evidence supports that link.

topics.headline: clear sign belongs to public proof vocabulary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the singular clear sign concentrates a wider proof formula into one public remnant.
topics.reason: The rows connect local b-y-n usage with sign vocabulary, people-addressed proof, same-surah clarity passages, and the wider clear-sign formula.

words.gloss_range: proclitic lām governing the recipient noun and orienting the sign toward purpose, benefit, or qualified audience
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) turns the established clear sign toward its audience. It governs the following people noun, so the recipients are grammatically dependent on a destination phrase. Purpose, benefit, and specialization all remain useful here: the sign is for people who can reason from it, not simply a remnant sitting in history. By opening the final beat after the evidence phrase, the particle makes the ayah land on who can read the proof. The recitational assimilation after the preceding tanwīn audibly joins the clear-sign phrase to its recipient phrase.

topics.headline: lām governs the people noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is grammatically dependent on a recipient phrase, not independently appended.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the following noun as governed by this preposition.

topics.headline: the sign is addressed for reasoning recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the evidence has an intended cognitive audience: it is for people who can reason from it.
topics.reason: The purposive, benefactive, and specialization readings all fit the local phrase leading into the reasoning qualifier.

topics.headline: final beat begins with destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah does not stop at proof; after establishing the clear sign, it turns to who can read it.
topics.reason: The lām phrase follows the completed evidence phrase and opens the closing audience qualification.

topics.headline: assimilation audibly ties clarity to recipients
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the clear-sign phrase joined into the recipient phrase, so sound reinforces the movement from evidence to audience.
topics.reason: The row is a surface-recitation observation and stays tied to the local transition from adjective to lām phrase.

words.gloss_range: indefinite genitive collective audience, open to any people characterized by reasoning rather than one named nation
words.root_gloss_range: range around standing, rising, establishing, people, collective, and community; the local noun selects a social audience, not an event of standing
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمٍ}} ({{tr:qawmin}}) names an indefinite collective audience under the lām. The openness matters: the sign is not restricted to one named nation but to any people characterized by reasoning. The root {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) adds the pressure of a constituted body that stands together, while the local noun remains a social audience rather than an event of standing. Structurally, this word pivots the ayah from evidence-object to interpreting community and waits for the final verb to complete the audience's definition. The recurring signs-for-peoples formula, including 2:164, 16:12, 30:24, and 45:5, makes reasoning a collective qualifier, while Surah 29 turns narrative peoples into an open reasoning class and returns to reason at 29:43. The nasal texture of the noun also prepares the final plural ending.

topics.headline: indefinite collective people remains open-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign is not restricted to one named historical group; any reasoning people can stand as its audience.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite genitive and collective singular, and the following reasoning clause supplies the qualifying class.

topics.headline: people are governed by the lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that audiencehood is built into the prepositional phrase, not added as a loose label.
topics.reason: The local noun is genitive under the lām prefix and functions as the recipient complement.

topics.headline: qawm names a constituted social body
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience is a social collective capable of standing before evidence, while the local noun remains people rather than a resurrection-standing term.
topics.reason: The q-w-m root family gives standing and establishment pressure, but the selected local form is the common people/community noun.

topics.headline: the final verb defines the people by reasoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are defined by rational action rather than lineage, ethnicity, or mere presence near the ruins.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final verb as a clause qualifying the people noun.

topics.headline: qawm joins signs-and-cognition formulas
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this audience phrase belongs to a broader Quranic grammar of signs for peoples who reason, including 2:164, 16:12, 30:24, and 45:5.
topics.reason: The supplied formula rows explicitly connect qawm with sign and reasoning contexts across the cited references.

topics.headline: narrative peoples become reasoning audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from the object of evidence to the interpreting audience, with Surah 29 turning narrative peoples into an open reasoning class and returning to reason at 29:43.
topics.reason: The rows describe the local pivot from sign to audience plus supplied same-surah recurrences, including the 29:43 comparison.

topics.headline: nasal texture prepares the final plural verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the recipient noun preparing the final plural reasoning ending.
topics.reason: The sound claim stays limited to local cadence and does not control the lexical parse.

words.gloss_range: active imperfect plural reasoning that qualifies the audience as habitually processing the sign
words.root_gloss_range: range around binding, restraining, understanding, and reasoning; the local imperfect verb selects active rational comprehension with restraint imagery as pressure
words.prose: {{ar:يَعْقِلُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿqilūna}}) closes the ayah by qualifying the people, with no explicit relative pronoun; the audience definition is compressed into the final verb. The active imperfect makes reasoning an ongoing act of the recipients, and the plural morphology carries the communal actors inside the final word. The root {{ar:ع ق ل}} ({{tr:ʿ-q-l}}) adds binding and restraint pressure: reason ties evidence to judgment rather than floating as cleverness. The whole sequence reaches this endpoint: the ruins become a clear sign, but the ayah lands on the people who actively understand it. The formula also joins supplied cross-surah cognition contexts such as 16:12, 30:24, and 45:5, generalizes the remnant for reasoning people, and anticipates the Surah 29 reason thread at 29:43. Across the boundary, destroyed transgressors give way to reasoning recipients, and the internal tanwīn cadence resolves into the final long plural ending.

topics.headline: final verb qualifies the people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the audience definition is compressed into a verb without an explicit relative pronoun.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final verb as a relative-like clause qualifying the preceding indefinite people noun.

topics.headline: reasoning is active and ongoing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reasoning is portrayed as practiced action, not a one-time completed possession.
topics.reason: The local verb is active imperfect 3mp, and the supplied distribution emphasizes imperfect usage for this root.

topics.headline: plural morphology makes cognition communal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word carries both cognition and its plural actors inside one compact form.
topics.reason: The ya-prefix and plural ending encode the subject within the verb and match the collective audience.

topics.headline: root binding image sharpens reason
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that reason is not mere cleverness; it carries the pressure of binding evidence to judgment and restraining impulse.
topics.reason: The binding and restraint root field is valid semantic pressure, but the local Form IV imperfect still selects reasoning as the active sense.

topics.headline: the ayah lands on the act of understanding
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the chain does not end at the ruins or the clear sign; it culminates in rational uptake of the evidence.
topics.reason: The final word position, sign/reasoning co-occurrence, and local evidence chain all support the cognitive endpoint payoff.

topics.headline: reasoning joins formula and surah-level thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this closing formula generalizes the remnant for reasoning people, echoes 16:12, 30:24, and 45:5, and anticipates the reason theme at 29:43.
topics.reason: The rows provide explicit cross-references and boundary contrasts, while local syntax keeps the phrase as the ayah-final qualifier.

topics.headline: final sound resolves the tanwīn chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the internal indefinite cadence resolve into the long plural ending of the final verb.
topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to local cadence and do not add an independent lexical claim.

baseline_models.mechanism: Leaving preserves an aftermath, while the sign and its clarity convert that remainder into exposed evidence.

activation_trace.role: The literal image is an effect kept behind after departure; it makes preservation, not accidental survival, the sign's material mechanism.
The literal visible mark turns the retained remainder into something that points beyond itself.
Manifest disclosure makes the remainder evidentially exposed rather than merely extant.

changed_reading.before: A clear sign happened to remain from the place.
changed_reading.after: An aftermath was retained so that what the event left behind could remain openly readable as evidence.

baseline_models.mechanism: The abandoned-place and exposed-ground branches make the sign a spatial remainder: a gap or residue on terrain where an inhabited continuity used to be.

activation_trace.role: A place or pooled residue left by people or a passing torrent supplies the literal terrain-after-passage image.
Separation after prior connection makes the site's rupture part of what becomes clear.
A tract of ground extending to sight gives the separation a visible spatial surface.
The visible-mark image promotes the altered ground from debris to sign.

changed_reading.before: The sign is an unspecified object left in the destroyed place.
changed_reading.after: The emptied or altered terrain itself may be the sign, with discontinuity and residue making former habitation legible.

baseline_models.mechanism: A human collective must rise to the evidence and bind its implications together; clarity names availability, not automatic comprehension.

activation_trace.role: The literal human group makes reception a shared social act rather than an isolated glance.
Rising with resolve supplies the group's active movement toward the evidential task.
Reason literally restrains ignorance, functioning as disciplined judgment rather than bare perception.
The tether image makes reasoning the act of holding observations together and stopping an evasive conclusion from wandering away.

changed_reading.before: A plainly visible object communicates its lesson by itself.
changed_reading.after: The trace becomes a sign only when a community actively binds sight to judgment and lets the evidence restrain ignorance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first denies that people will simply be left after professing belief and places them under assay; the focus later says a sign is left after a communal ordeal. The repeated leaving moves from release without testing to evidence preserved by testing.

activation_trace.role: Preserving an effect after leaving anchors the focus sign as post-event evidence.
The visible mark is the retained output that can be inspected after the test.
Being let go without further action supplies the release that the opening question explicitly denies.
Supposition supplies the mistaken expectation that an untested claim is sufficient.
Assaying metal or persons supplies the ordeal that separates claim from disclosed condition.

structural_cues: 29:2 uses passive ت ر ك to deny release from trial, while 29:35 uses active ت ر ك for a trace preserved after catastrophe.
The opening test question and the focus's retained sign place evidence after, not before, exposure to ordeal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence sorts a settlement into destroyed inhabitants, a household extracted by separation, one member remaining with what passes, and a punishment that lands. The focus sign is therefore a remainder of a remainder, recording the selection itself.

strongest_changes: The opening denial of untested leaving turns the focus remnant into post-assay evidence rather than accidental debris.
The Noah and Lot units form complementary sign media: a rescued carrier is made a sign, while a destroyed site's remainder is left as one.
The local rescue, exception, descent, and residue sequence makes the sign display selective separation.
The dwellings, catastrophe catalog, and spider-house example turn the clear remnant into comparative and analogical material that must be reasoned.
The later clear signs in breasts and recited book shift preservation from external matter to embodied and textual memory.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly replays the focus's leaving, sign, clarity, people, and reasoning through tests, paired catastrophes, dwellings, examples, and textual signs. The focus therefore became an interface between retained matter and disciplined inference, while preserving several distinct mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact referent of منها remains open among the settlement, its destruction, and the punishment's aftermath.
The packet does not identify the physical form of the retained sign, so terrain, structure, and discrete artifact remain competing realizations.
The antecedent of the Noah unit's feminine pronoun may be the vessel, rescue, or episode, which affects the precision of the paired-sign contrast.
Later reasoning and textual-sign echoes may deliberately reinterpret the focus or may only establish parallel sign classes.
The ecological and protected-enclave readings are branch-backed but should remain exploratory rather than be synthesized into a literal claim.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Leaving as preservation of an effect.** ت ر ك B002 is “leaving an effect to remain,” distinct from B001's simply letting go. The source-place survives only through a clear sign addressed to people who reason. I infer that destruction is made cognitively traversable by preserving a residue; “we left” reads as deliberate retention of evidence rather than unattended remainder.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:38 immediately identifies visible dwellings as evidence. The later ayah fills the retained sign with material residue and shows that clarity still requires correct evaluation rather than eyesight alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Destruction leaves an evidentiary effect rather than an empty absence.** Lexical evidence: `تَرَكْنَا`, root `ت ر ك`, `B002` (leaving an effect to remain); `ءَايَة`, root `ء ي ي`, `B003` (visible sign); and `بَيِّنَة`, root `ب ي ن`, `B004` (appearance and becoming clear). Structural cue: `29:31-34` remove inhabitants through rescue and ruin, but this ayah insists that something from the site remains; `29:38` soon says former dwellings have become clear to the addressees. Assigned role: the remaining effect carries the destroyed event into later visibility. Abductive move: the packet does not inventory the sign's material form; I infer only that residue mediates absent event to present observer. Reading change: “we left” is not neglect but deliberate preservation of evidence.

2. **Understanding is the restraint that lets a ruin alter conduct.** Lexical evidence: `يَعْقِلُون`, root `ع ق ل`, `B001` (understanding as restraint from ignorance). Structural cue: the sign is assigned to a people who restrain; `29:36` immediately prohibits spreading corruption, while `29:38` describes people who possessed insight yet were turned from the way. Assigned role: understanding binds perception to behavioral inhibition. Abductive move: the packet supplies visible residue and the restraining branch; I infer that a sign succeeds when it prevents repetition, not merely when its meaning is decoded. Reading change: reason becomes an ethical tether activated by historical remains.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:38`, `29:43`):** Clear dwellings directly realize the effect left behind, and the parable statement generalizes how such effects work: a visible relation must be grasped by restraining understanding. The retained sign is therefore both material residue and a prototype for causal analogy.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 (29:28-44) Routes and Forums Turned Hostile
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Shared channels for movement and speech are converted from public access into mechanisms of obstruction and abuse.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The passage links highway robbery, worked tracks, water access, public council, loud circulation, and the restraint or excess of the tongue.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The Abusive Public Council
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A gathered council raises speech into public noise, circulates shame, and lets verbal reach exceed rational restraint.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: gathered council and consultation `quranic:root_001486:B001/m01`; raised public call `quranic:root_001486:B002/m01`; shame-producing words `quranic:root_001486:B005/m01`; excessive and far-reaching speech `quranic:root_000512:B011/m01`; a prolific speaker `quranic:root_001272:B003/m01`; talk circulating among people `quranic:root_001272:B007/m01`; tongue held back from speech `quranic:root_001036:B003/m01`; an act so hard or strange that it is rejected `quranic:root_001550:B003/m01`; verbal answer and exchange `quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The forum is not a neutral venue but an amplifier: gathering, raised voice, circulating talk, and shame-producing language create the social force of the act. The restrained tongue of عقل provides the exact counter-operation to a council whose speech has overextended its reach.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truth becomes cognitively usable when it is marked, modeled, and impressed into a form that can restrain mistaken judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Parable-making behaves like heraldry, model-making, molding, and tethering: cognition is given a durable form and then held to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Mark, Landmark, and Inward Sight
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A distinguishing trace remains in the landscape, directs attention, and becomes inward recognition rather than bare looking.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: manifest sign `quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`; retained route-guiding landmark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m02`; emergence into visible clarity `quranic:root_000170:B004/m01`; gestural clarification `quranic:root_000170:B005/m02`; inward sight and evidentiary understanding `quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`; retained trace after departure `quranic:root_000180:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The "clear sign" left from the town is a trace that functions like a landmark: it first catches sight, then opens meaning, then becomes inward evidence. Remains are useful because they preserve direction after the event itself has departed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A truth becomes cognitively usable when it is marked, modeled, and impressed into a form that can restrain mistaken judgment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Parable-making behaves like heraldry, model-making, molding, and tethering: cognition is given a durable form and then held to it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Struck Model and Rational Restraint
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A maker strikes or stamps a representative form so that observers can compare structures and bind judgment to the demonstrated relation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: proverbial formulation `quranic:root_001397:B003/m01`; represented model or image `quranic:root_001397:B008/m01`; example serving as an instructive sign `quranic:root_001397:B011/m01`; rendering an example explicit `quranic:root_000906:B003/m01`; type or mold for repeated form `quranic:root_000906:B007/m01`; striking tool `quranic:root_000906:B014/m02`; craft of striking `quranic:root_000906:B014/m03`; reason that restrains ignorance `quranic:root_001036:B001/m01`; tethering a moving animal `quranic:root_001036:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: To "strike" an example is to make a repeatable model whose form carries an invariant relation. عقل contributes both understanding and tether: the comparison checks wandering judgment by fastening it to a visible structure.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali bir seyi birakma, ondan el cekme, onu almama ya da onunla is yapmama olarak kurar. Bu vazgecis isteyerek de zorunlulukla da olabilir; dal, bir seyi belirli bir halde kilma veya olumden sonra kalan mal gibi adlasmis ozel kullanimlari kapsamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Cekirdek anlam bir nesneden el cekmedir; halde birakma, kalit, yumurta ve kisi toplulugu anlamlari disarida kalir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalgin adlasmis bicimi hem de kaliplasmis bir olumsuz anlatimi icerir; tanim bunlari tek bir nesneden el cekme cekirdegine baglar.

concept_map.definition: Bir seyi almaktan, elde tutmaktan ya da onun uzerinde eylemde bulunmaktan el cekme; bu el cekme isteyerek veya zorunlulukla gerceklesebilir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyle ilgi, alma ya da is yapma bagini kesip onu kendi haline birakma.
El cekme bazen bilincli secimle, bazen de zorunlu durumda ortaya cikar.
Olumsuz anlatimda hicbir sey birakmama anlamina gelen kalip da ayni el cekme alanina baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dali bir seyi birakma, saliverme, reddetme ya da onunla is yapmama ortak alaninda toplar; tekil olumsuz kalip da bu alana bagli bir kullanimdir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Nesneyle bagin kesildigi ve onu alma ya da onunla is yapma yonunden geri duruldugu temel dal icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Nesneden el cekme ve onu almama ya da islememe cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesneden vazgecmeyi veya onu almadan geride tutmayi anlatan duz baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Gundelik dilde nesneden el cekme hareketini korur.
error_profile.adds: Turkcede birini bir yerde tutma veya bir sonucu o halde kilma anlamlarina da genisleyebilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilerek ve secerek bir seyden el cekmeyi one cikaran baglamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Secimli el cekme tarafini korur.
error_profile.loses: Zorunlulukla ya da caresizlikle gerceklesen el cekmeyi tek basina tam karsilamaz.

error_profile.loses: Bu dalin eylemsel el cekme cekirdegini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Olumden sonra kalan mal veya hak alanini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Ayni kokun ayri bir dali olan olumden sonra kalan seyle karisir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayni kok icinde olumsuz hicbir sey birakmama kalibini de tasir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komsu dal cok genis bir saliverme ve ihmal etme alani acar; bu dal ise kaynak sozunde bir seyi almama, reddetme ve ondan el cekme cekirdeginde tutulur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de ayni kokun birakma alanina temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesneyle bagin kesilmesini anlatir; komsu dalda ise nesne uzerindeki eylem bir durum sonucuyla biter.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da ayrilma veya geride kalma fikri vardir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ودع الشيء ورفضه وتخليته، قصدا واختيارا أو قهرا واضطرارا، وترك الشيء بلا أخذ ولا فعل

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali bir seyden el cekme eyleminin otesinde, kisinin uzerinde iyi bir anilma birakilmasi veya sahiplerinin ardindan seylerin kalmasi olarak aciklar. Bu nedenle dalin cekirdegi yalniz vazgecis degil, geride kalan iz veya seyin korunmasidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalgin kullanimdadir; sadece reddetme, halde kilma veya olum sonrasi mal adiyla karistirilmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalgin dal olarak tanim, belirli bir kaliba baglanmadan geride iz veya sey kalmasi anlamini verir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kisinin ardinda iyi anilma gibi bir izin korunmasi veya seylerin sahiplerinden sonra geride kalmasi.

facets.statement: El cekmeden sonra bir iz, anilma ya da sey geride kalir ve varligini surdurur.
Bir kisi uzerinde iyi anilmanin kalmasi bu dalin orneklerinden biridir.
Sahipleri ayrildiktan sonra bahce gibi seylerin geride kalmasi da bu alana girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali bir seyi arkada kalir halde tutma veya sahibinden sonra geride kalan varlik ve iyi anilma uzerinden ortak bicimde kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Birakmadan sonra anilma, etki veya seylerin geride kalmasi soz konusu oldugunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geride kalan iz veya sey cekirdegini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iz ya da seyin birakma sonucunda geride kalmasini anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da gecmis bir seyin ardindan kalan belirti veya etki vardir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adaylar arasindan iz ve bakiye alanina en yakin olanlar secildi; obur adaylar iyi anilma, unutma veya yok etme gibi daha uzak yonlerden baglaniyordu.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإبقاء والتخليف، ومنه أن يترك على الشخص ذكر حسن أو تترك الأشياء خلف أصحابها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الرفض المجرد بلا بقاء أثر، ولا الجعل بمعنى التصيير، ولا اسم التركة الموروثة
branches.source_phrase_ar: الترك الإبقاء وتركنا عليه أي أبقينا عليه ذكرا حسنا (tahdhib)؛ ومن الثاني كم تركوا من جنات (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali bir seyi belirli bir hale getiren ya da eylemin sonucunda o halde birakan yapilara baglar. Bir kaynak bu kullanimin her soz icinde gecerli olmadigini bildirir, bu yuzden dal korunur ama yalgin birakma anlamina genisletilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal sadece belirtilen hal yapisinda gecerlidir; nesneden el cekme veya anilma birakma anlamlari buraya tasinmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kolokasyon dali oldugu icin tanim, nesne ve belirtilen hal iceren yapidan ayrilarak yalgin anlam haline getirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Birini veya bir seyi, yapilan eylemin sonunda belirtilen duruma gelmis halde birakma ya da o hale getirme.

facets.statement: Eylem, nesnenin veya kisinin belirtilen bir durumda kalmasiyla sonuclanir.
Kullanim, bir seyi o hale getirme anlamiyla isler ve yalgin vazgecme anlami degildir.
Bir aktarim bu kullanimin sinirli ve tartismali oldugunu, her sozde ana anlam sayilmamasi gerektigini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali nesnenin belirtilen bir hale gelmesi veya o halde kalmasi yapisi olarak verir; ayni toplu id icinde bu kullanimin sinirli sayilabilecegi notu da bulunur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen hal ve eylem sonucu cekirdegini korur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولهم تركته كذا إذا انتهى الفعل بالشيء إلى حالة، ويجري مجرى جعلته كذا، مثل ترك الحبل شديدا
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه ترك الشيء بمعنى رفضه أو تخليته، ولا الإبقاء بمعنى حفظ الذكر
branches.source_phrase_ar: الترك الجعل في بعض الكلام تقول تركت الحبل شديدا أي جعلته (ayn;tahdhib)؛ قد يقال في كل فعل ينتهي به إلى حالة ما تركته كذا أو يجري مجرى جعلته كذا نحو تركت فلانا وحيدا (mufradat)؛ يقال تركت الحبل شديدا أي جعلته شديدا وما أحسب هذا من كلام الخليل (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali olağan cekimli fiil olarak degil, birak anlamli buyruk yerine kullanilan kaliplasmis bir soz olarak verir. Bu nedenle dal, hem tek tarafli nesneden el cekme eyleminden hem de karsilikli ayrilma yapisindan ayridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalniz buyruk yerine gecen kaliplasmis soze aittir; genel birakma fiili veya karsilikli cekilme degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalgin kok anlami degil, belirli kaliplasmis soz bicimi oldugu icin tanim bu ozel soyleyisle sinirlanir.

concept_map.definition: Birak anlamindaki buyrugu cekimli fiil yerine kaliplasmis tek bir sozle ifade etme.

facets.statement: Soz, muhataba birakmasini isteyen buyruk degeri tasir.
Bu deger siradan fiil cekiminden degil, buyruk yerine gecen kaliplasmis ad-sozden gelir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali birak anlamli bir buyruk yerine kullanilan kaliplasmis soz olarak ortak bicimde tanitir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Cekimli fiil degil, birakmasini emreden kaliplasmis soz anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Buyruk degeri ve kaliplasmis soz sinirini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Okur icin buyruk degerini dogrudan gostermek gerektiginde kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Buyruk anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaliplasmis soz bicimi oldugunu tek basina gostermez.

error_profile.preserves: Birakma alanina uzak bir bag kurar.
error_profile.loses: Tek muhataba yonelen buyruk sozunu kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Iki tarafli ayrilma veya anlasmali vazgecme anlamini ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal birak anlamli buyruk sozudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal engelleme veya men etme anlamli buyruk sozudur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de fiil cekimi yerine buyruk gibi isleyen kaliplasmis sozlerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak bicimsel isleyise karsin bu dal birakmayi, komsu dal ise men etmeyi emreder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek tarafli buyruk sozu bu dalin merkezidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal iki taraf arasinda ayrilma veya satisi birakma yapisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de birakma alanina bagli ozel bicimlerdir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal soylemde emir degeri tasir; komsu dal ise taraflar arasinda gerceklesen karsilikli eylemi anlatir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Buyruk sozu adaylari ve ayni kokun yakin dallari degerlendirildi; yayimlananlar bicimsel buyruk ile karsiliklilik ayrimini aciklar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تراك إذا استعمل اسما لفعل الأمر بمعنى اترك
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه المتاركة بين اثنين ولا مطلق ترك الشيء بصيغة الفعل المعتادة
branches.source_phrase_ar: تراك بمعنى اترك وهو اسم لفعل الأمر (sihah)؛ وتراك بمعنى أترك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali iki taraf arasinda satisi birakma veya arkadasliktan ayrilma gibi karsilikli cekilme alaninda kurar. Bu, tek tarafli birakma ya da buyruk sozu degil, iliskide iki yanli vazgecis ve ayrilma yapisidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal karsilikli ya da taraflar arasi yapilarla sinirlidir; tek nesneyi birakma veya buyruk sozu degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kolokasyon dali oldugu icin tanim, taraflar ve ozellikle satis ya da arkadaslik iliskisi iceren yapidan genellestirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Iki tarafin bir satisi, birlikteligi veya arkadaslik bagini karsilikli olarak birakmasi ya da birbirinden ayrilmasi.

facets.statement: Eylem tek tarafli degil, iki taraf arasinda karsilikli cekilme veya ayrilma bicimindedir.
Satisi karsilikli olarak birakma bu dalin acik bir baglamidir.
Arkadasliktan ayrilma benzeri anlatim da ayni karsilikli ayrilma alanina baglanir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali satisi birakma ve arkadasliktan ayrilma gibi iki tarafli cekilme alaninda toplar; ortak nokta taraflar arasindaki bagin sona ermesidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Iki tarafin satis ya da iliski bagindan birlikte ayrildigi baglamlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Iki taraflilik ve bagdan cekilme cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Satis veya benzeri bir isin iki tarafca birakildigi baglamlarda dogaldir.

error_profile.preserves: Iki tarafli vazgecis anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Arkadasliktan ayrilma gibi satis disi karsilikli ayrilmalari tek basina tam kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Arkadaslik veya birliktelik baginin karsilikli kesildigi baglamlarda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Karsilikli ayrilma yonunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Satisi birakma gibi islem baglamlarini eksik birakir.

error_profile.preserves: Birakma alanina gevsek bir bag tasir.
error_profile.loses: Iki tarafli cekilme ve anlasmali ayrilma cekirdegini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Tek muhataba yonelen buyruk degerini ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal karsilikli birakma veya anlasmali cekilme ile sinirlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal ayrilma ve uzaklasma fikrini daha genel bicimde tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir bagin sona ermesi alaninda bulusur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal taraflarin bir isi veya iliskiyi birakmasini ister; komsu dalda karsilikli anlasma ya da satis baglami zorunlu degildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karsilikli taraf yapisi bu dalin siniridir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal tek nesneden el cekme olarak isler.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de birakma alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal iki tarafli bagin cozulmesini anlatir; komsu dal bir nesneyle bagin tek tarafli kesilmesini anlatabilir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Ayrilma, anlasma ve ayni kok adaylari degerlendirildi; en acik ayrim karsiliklilik kosulunda toplandi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تاركه ومتاركته إذا وقعت مفارقة أو ترك متبادل بين صاحبين أو في بيع
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الأمر تراك ولا ترك الشيء من طرف واحد
branches.source_phrase_ar: تاركته البيع متاركة (sihah)؛ فاركت صاحبي مثل تاركته فهذا من باب الإبدال (maqayis-ibdal)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali olen kisinin ardinda biraktigi varlik ve kalit olarak kurar. Bu dal genel anlamda geride birakma degil, olumden sonra kalan seye ad olan ozel bir alandir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal olumden sonra kalan varlikla sinirlidir; siradan geride birakma, iyi anilma veya bir seyi reddetme degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalgin adlasmis dal olarak tanim, belirli bir kolokasyona degil olumden sonra kalan seyin kendisine odaklanir.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanin olumunden sonra ardinda kalan mal, varlik veya edinim.

facets.statement: Referans noktasi bir insanin olumudur; seyler onun ardinda kalir.
Anlam kalan varligin kendisine ad olur, birakma eyleminin geneline degil.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali olen kisiden sonra geride kalan varlik ya da edinim adi olarak ortak bicimde verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Olumden sonra kisinin ardinda kalan mal veya varlik anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Olum sonrasi geride kalan varlik cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Okura tek sozcuklu karsilik gerektiginde ve olum sonrasi kalan mal anlaminda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Olumden sonra kalan sey anlamini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel varlik ve edinim alaninin mal disi yonlerini daraltabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Geride kalma fikrini korur.
error_profile.loses: Olumden sonra kalan varlik adi olma ozelligini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Iyi anilma veya iz kalmasi alanini ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal olen kisinin ardinda kalan varligin kendisidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal olumden sonra yapilan ogut, bagis veya gorevlendirme alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de olumden sonraki mal ve duzenleme alanina temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kalan seyi adlandirir; komsu dal o seyin aktarilmasi veya birine yuklenmesi yonundeki hukuki-sozlu duzenlemeyi anlatir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olumden sonra kalan varlikla sinirlidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal iyi anilma veya sahiplerinden sonra kalan seyler gibi daha genel iz ve kalinti alani tasir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da bir ayrilisin ardindan geride kalan sey bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalin belirleyici kosulu olumdur; komsu dalda olum sart degildir ve iyi anilma gibi soyut izler de bulunur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Olum, varlik ve arda kalma adaylari karsilastirildi; yayimlanan ayrimlar kalan seyin kendisi ile onu duzenleyen veya daha genel iz alanini ayirir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه تركة الميت وتراثه المتروك وما يخلفه الإنسان بعد موته
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه مطلق الأشياء المتروكة بغير موت، ولا الإبقاء بمعنى إبقاء الذكر
branches.source_phrase_ar: تركة الميت تراثه المتروك (sihah)؛ تركة فلان لما يخلفه بعد موته (mufradat)؛ تركه الميت ما يتركه من تراثه (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali evlenmeden birakilan kadin ve ailesinin evinde kalan evlenmemis kadin olarak verir; ayrica bir erkeğin boyle bir kadinla evlenmesi de ayni ozel leksik alana baglanir. Bu dal yumurta adi veya olumden sonra kalan mal anlamindan ayridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kadinin evlenmeden birakilmasi ve buna bagli evlenme yapisiyla sinirlidir; yumurta ve kalit anlamlari disaridadir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem adlasmis kadin adini hem de bu kadinla evlenme kolokasyonunu icerir; tanim ikisini ayni toplumsal durum etrafinda ayirarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Evlenmeden birakilmis veya ailesinin evinde evlenmeden kalmis kadin; ilgili kalipta, boyle bir kadinla evlenme.

facets.statement: Kadinin belirleyici durumu evlenmeden birakilmis veya evlenmeden kalmis olmasidir.
Ailesinin evinde evlenmeden kalma ayrintisi bu sosyal durumu daraltir.
Bir erkeğin boyle bir kadinla evlenmesini anlatan kalip ayni dalin bagli kullanimidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali evlenmeden birakilan kadin ve bu kadinla evlenme bagli kullanimi etrafinda ortak bicimde kurar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kadinin kimse tarafindan es olarak alinmamis veya ailesinde evlenmeden kalmis durumunu anlatir.

error_profile.preserves: Kadin, evlenmeme ve birakilmislik cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ailesinin evinde evlenmeden kalma ayrintisi one ciktiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Evlenmeden kalma durumunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Kimsenin onunla evlenmemesi ve birakilmislik vurgusunu azaltabilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bagli fiil yapisinda erkeğin bu durumdaki kadinla evlenmesi anlatildiginda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Bagli evlenme kullanimini korur.
Ayni ad biciminin baska dalini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kadinin evlenmeden birakilmis olmasini tumuyle kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kadinin baskalari tarafindan evlenilmeden birakilmasi ozel durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal es bulunmama veya evlilik baginin olmamasi alanini erkek ve kadin icin daha genel verir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de evlilik baginin yoklugu alaninda bulusur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal kadina ve birakilmislik durumuna odaklanir; komsu dal es yoklugunu daha genel bir toplumsal durum olarak verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insan ve evlenme durumu uzerinedir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal birakilmis yumurta ve ona benzetilen baslik anlamindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisinde de birakilmisliktan tureyen adlasma bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal toplumsal bir kadin durumunu anlatir; komsu dal nesne adi ve benzetme alanina aittir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Evlilik, es yoklugu ve ayni ad bicimini paylasan adaylar degerlendirildi; en yararli ayrim kadin durumu ile nesne adi arasindadir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التريكة من النساء، وهي المرأة التي تترك فلا يتزوجها أحد، والعانس في بيت أبويها
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه بيض النعام المسمى تريكة، ولا التركة الموروثة، ولا مطلق ترك الشيء
branches.source_phrase_ar: التريكة من النساء التي تترك فلا يتزوجها أحد (sihah)؛ ترك الرجل إذا تزوج بالتريكة وهي العانس في بيت أبويها (tahdhib)؛ امرأة تريكة وهي التي تترك فلا تتزوج (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali bozkirda birakilan deve kusu yumurtasi, bununla iliskili yumurta adlari ve yumurtaya benzetilen demir baslik ya da bas koruyucu olarak kurar. Bu nedenle cekirdek birakilmis yumurta ve ondan dogan benzetmedir; kadin veya cayir anlamlari disarida kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yumurta ve yumurtaya benzetilen baslik alanindadir; kadin, su birikintisi, cayir ve insan toplulugu anlamlari dahil degildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalgin ad bicimleri bir arada verildigi icin tanim, belirli bir kaliba degil yumurta ve benzetilen nesne alanina baglanir.

concept_map.definition: Bozkirda birakilmis deve kusu yumurtasi ve bu yumurtaya bicimce benzetilen demir baslik ya da bas koruyucu.

facets.statement: Cekirdek nesne, acik alanda birakilmis deve kusu yumurtasidir.
Birden cok ad bicimi bu yumurta alanina baglanir.
Yumurtaya benzeyen demir baslik veya bas koruyucu bu cekirdekten benzetmeyle turetilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali birakilmis deve kusu yumurtasi ve ona benzeyen demir baslik alaninda toplar; farkli ad bicimleri ayni cekirdek ve benzetme iliskisine baglidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Cekirdek nesne olan acik alanda birakilmis deve kusu yumurtasi icin en dogal karsiliktir.

error_profile.preserves: Birakilmis yumurta cekirdegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumurtaya benzetilen demir baslik uzantisi tek basina kapsanmaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yumurtaya benzetilen savas basligi veya bas koruyucu anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Demir baslik uzantisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Birakilmis deve kusu yumurtasi cekirdegini disarida birakir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Birakilmislik ayrintisinin zayif oldugu yumurta adi baglamlarinda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Yumurta nesnesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Acik alanda birakilmis olma ayrintisini eksiltir.

error_profile.preserves: Birakilmisliktan dogan adlasma bagini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yumurta ve demir baslik nesne alanini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yumurtanin kendisini ve ona benzetilen basligi anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal deve kusunun yumurtladigi yer veya yuva alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de deve kusu yumurtasi cevresindeki adlandirmalara temas eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adi ve benzetmedir; komsu dal yumurtanin birakildigi yer veya yuva anlamina yonelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalda demir baslik, birakilmis yumurta cekirdeginden benzetmeyle aciklanir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal demir basligi baska bir nesneye benzetme yoluyla adlandirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dal da demir baslik veya bas koruyucu anlaminda kesisir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kullanim ayni nesneye yaklasabilir, fakat bu dalin aciklayici cekirdegi birakilmis yumurta ve ondan gelen benzetmedir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yumurta ve baslik nesnelerine aittir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal selden kalan su veya otlatilmamis cayir gibi yer ve su alanindadir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ikisi de bir sey tarafindan birakilmis olma fikrinden adlasir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal bicim ve nesneye, komsu dal ise geride kalmis su ya da insanlarca atlanmis otlak yere odaklanir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Yumurta, baslik ve benzetme adaylari karsilastirildi; yayimlananlar nesne, yer ve benzetilen savas basligi sinirlarini gosterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه بيض النعام المتروك في الفلاة، والتريكة والتركة والتركية، وما شبه به من بيضة السلاح أو بيضة الرأس

branches.source_phrase_ar: الترك ضرب من البيض مستدير شبيه بالتركة والتركية وهي بيض النعام (ayn)؛ التريكة بيضة النعام التي تتركها والتركة البيضة من الحديد والجمع ترك (sihah)؛ الترك البيض للرأس واحدته تركة (tahdhib)؛ التريكة أصله البيض المتروك في مفازته ويسمى بيضة الحديد بها (mufradat)؛ تسمى البيضة بالعراء تريكة وتركه السلاح وهي البيضة محمول على هذا ومشبه به (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sozu bu dali selin gecip geride durgun biraktigi su ve insanlarin gozden kacirip otlatmadigi cayir olarak iki bagli ornekle kurar. Her iki ornekte de bir yer veya kaynak, gecilmis ya da ihmal edilmis oldugu icin geride kalir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal su birikintisi ve otlatilmamis cayir alanindadir; yumurta, kadin ve olum sonrasi kalan varlik anlamlari disaridadir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalgin ad bicimleriyle verildigi icin tanim, belirli bir soz kalibina degil geride kalmis su veya atlanmis cayir adina baglanir.

concept_map.definition: Selin gecip ardinda durgun biraktigi su veya insanlarin fark etmeyip otlatmadan biraktigi cayirlik yer.

facets.statement: Bir yer veya kaynak, gecilme ya da ihmal edilme sonucu geride ve kullanilmamis kalir.
Selin gecmesinden sonra durgun kalan su bu dalin bir ornegidir.
Insanlarin gozden kacirip otlatmadigi cayirlik yer de ayni alana girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dali selden sonra kalan su ve insanlarca otlatilmadan gecilen cayirlik yer ornekleriyle aciklar; ortak nokta bir kaynak veya yerin geride kalmasidir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Selin geride biraktigi su ya da insanlarca otlatilmadan atlanan cayirlik yer icin uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Su ve cayir ornekleriyle geride kalma cekirdegini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Su birikintisi ornegi acik oldugunda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Selden sonra kalan durgun suyu korur.
error_profile.loses: Otlatilmamis cayir ornegini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Insanlarin gozden kacirip hayvan sokmadigi cayirlik yer anlatildiginda kullanilir.

error_profile.preserves: Atlanmis ve kullanilmamis cayir ornegini korur.
error_profile.loses: Selden kalan su ornegini kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Birakilmislik bagini yalniz uzak bicimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Su ve otlatilmamis cayir cekirdegini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Yumurta nesnesi ve benzetme alanini ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayni zamanda otlatilmadan gecilmis cayiri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal suyun yagmur veya selden sonra birikmesi ve dolmasi alanina odaklanir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da sel veya yagmurdan sonra kalan su birikintisi bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Su orneginde anlamlar cok yakindir, fakat bu dal su disinda insanlarca atlanmis cayir anlamini da tasir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cayirin insanlarca fark edilmeyip otlatilmadan kalmasini ister.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komsu dal kokulu veya otlu cayirlik alanin kendisini anlatir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Iki dalda da otlu yesil yer alanina temas vardir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalin ayirt edici yani ihmal edilme veya gecilip birakilma durumudur; komsu dalda bu kosul bulunmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal anlamı açıkça ortaya koyma ve sözü anlaşılır olma durumudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal konuşmada tutulma, yetersizlik ve anlatım güçsüzlüğüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da konuşma ve anlamı aktarabilme eksenindedir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal açıklığı ve anlaşılır anlatımı verir; komşu dal bunun yokluğu veya aksamasını verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal anlamı bir araçla açıklama etkinliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal şeyin açık hale gelmesi veya belirgin kanıt olmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da açıklık ve anlaşılır hale gelme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal ifade edici eyleme bağlıdır; komşu dal nesnenin belirginleşmesine veya kanıt niteliğine bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; konuşma yetkinliği, anlatım eksikliği ve genel görünürlük sınırları yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البيان بوصفه كشفا عن المعنى، والكلام أو الكتابة أو الإشارة التي تبين المقصود، والفصاحة واللسن.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس كل ظهور حسي بيانا لفظيا، ولا يدخل فيه مجرد الفراق أو الوسط.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أبين من فلان أي أوضح كلاما منه (maqayis)؛ البين من الرجال الفصيح (ayn)؛ البيان الفصاحة واللسن (sihah)؛ البيان الكشف عن الشيء وهو أعم من النطق (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi uzaklık ve geniş mesafe çekirdeğini, kuyu örneğinde ise ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklığı verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu doğru taşır ve üstünlük anlamına kayan başka kullanımları dışarıda tutar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal uzak mesafe ve büyük açıklıkla sınırlıdır; ayrılık olayı veya üstünlük anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel kalıp yerine mesafe ve geniş açıklık çekirdeğini verir.

concept_map.definition: İki nokta, taraf veya yüzey arasında büyük uzaklık ve geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır; kuyu gibi nesnelerde ağız ile dip arasındaki uzaklık olarak görünür.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam iki şey arasında büyük uzaklık veya geniş açıklık bulunmasıdır.
Kuyu için ağız ile dip arasının uzak veya geniş olması örneklenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar uzaklık çekirdeğini verir; kuyu örneği bu uzaklığı somut bir ağız-dip mesafesi ve genişlik olarak gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Taraflar veya yüzeyler arasında belirgin mesafe ve açıklık bulunduğunda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Büyük mesafe, açıklık ve uzaklık çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İki taraf arasındaki mesafenin büyüklüğünü anlatan cümlelerde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Taraflar arası büyük uzaklık fikrini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal uzaklık durumunu genel bir mesafe ve açıklık olarak verir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iki şeyin birbirinden ne kadar uzak olduğunu haber verme kalıbına daha bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da iki şey arasındaki büyük uzaklık alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal uzak mesafe niteliğini isimsel olarak kurar; komşu dal uzaklığın bildirilmesi ve uyumsuzluk hissiyle kullanılabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iki uç arasında açıklık veya aralık mesafesi kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yakın olmama durumunu genel mekansal veya soyut uzaklık olarak anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yakın olmama ve mesafe alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal aradaki mesafenin genişliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal uzaklık durumunu daha genel tutar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal mesafe ve açıklığın büyüklüğüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ayrılıp kopma olayını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Ayrılma sonucunda uzak mesafe ortaya çıkabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal son durumda ölçülen uzaklığı verir; komşu dal uzaklığı doğurabilen ayrılma veya kopma olayını verir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yayımlanan sınırlar uzaklık, genel mesafe ve ayrılma sonucuyla ilgilidir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البعد بين طرفين، والبئر البعيدة القعر أو الواسعة التي يبعد ما بين شفيرها وقعرها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه البون بمعنى الفضل والمزية إذا غلبت عليه الواو، ولا مجرد الفراق بلا دلالة بعد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو بعد الشيء (maqayis)؛ البائنة البئر البعيدة القعر الواسعة (sihah)؛ بيون لبعد ما بين الشفير والقعر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi toprağın göz erimine kadar uzanan parçası, yönü veya yüksekçe kalın bölgesi olarak dar bir arazi adını verir. Geçici çerçeve yer adlarını ve sırf ara-konumu dışarıda tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın dal arazi parçası veya yönüyle sınırlıdır; iki şey arasındaki genel aralık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım özel ad veya kalıp değil, arazi parçası anlamını verir.

concept_map.definition: Gözün uzanabildiği ölçüde görülen bir arazi parçası, tarafı, yöresi veya yer yer kabarık bölgesidir.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam göz erimine kadar uzanan bir arazi parçasıdır.
Bazı anlatımlar bunu arazi yönü, bölgesi veya kabarık sert kesimi olarak verir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar arazi parçası çekirdeğinde birleşir; anlatımlar bu parçayı göz erimi, yön veya kabarık yer parçası olarak değişik açılardan tarif eder.

concept_gloss.applicability: Gözle seçilebilen genişlikte bir yer kesimi veya yöre anlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Arazi parçası, yöre ve göz erimi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Gözle görülebilen yer parçası veya yöre anlamındaki akıcı kullanımlar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer parçası ve bölge niteliğini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: göz erimindeki arazi parçası, yöre veya kabarık yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal göz erimiyle ölçülen arazi kesimi veya yön olarak tarif edilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yanındakinden ayrışan leke, parça veya yer kesimi fikrini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da arazide seçilen bir kesimi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal göz erimi ve yöre ölçüsünü vurgular; komşu dal seçilebilir parça veya leke niteliğini öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli bir arazi kesimi, yönü veya kabarık parçasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geniş, düz ve açık alan niteliğine yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yeryüzündeki geniş veya seçilebilir alanları anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal parçalanmış veya yönlenmiş bir arazi kesimidir; komşu dal açıklık ve genişlik niteliğini temel alır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cins isim olarak arazi parçasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal belirli bir dağ veya yer adı olarak geçer.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da coğrafi alanla ilişkilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal tür adı olarak arazi kesimidir; komşu dal özel bir yer adıdır ve aynı anlam alanında tanımsal eşleşme kurmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; yer parçası, geniş arazi ve özel yer adı ayrımları en yararlı olanlardır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: البين قطعة من الأرض قدر مد البصر (maqayis)؛ البين الغلظ من الأرض (jamhara)؛ البين بالكسر القطعة من الأرض قدر منتهى البصر (sihah)؛ البين أيضا الناحية (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli beden, yay ve baş örneklerinde bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrılması veya uzaklaşmasını verir. Geçici çerçeve bunu özel kalıplara bağlı tuttuğu sürece doğrudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca verilen cisimsel kalıplardaki ayrılma ve açıklıkla sınırlıdır; genel toplumsal ayrılık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam kalıp kullanımına bağlıdır; tanım bu özel cisimsel örneklerden yalın kök anlamı üretmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli cisimsel kalıplarda bir organın, yayın teli gibi bir parçanın ya da başın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması, açılması veya koparılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam temas eden veya bağlı parçanın bulunduğu yerden ayrılmasıdır.
Hayvan uzvunun gövdeden açılması ve yay telinin gövdeden uzak durması örneklenir.
Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrılması aynı cisimsel koparma alanındadır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar belirli cisimsel örneklerde ayrılma çekirdeğini verir; bu çekirdek organ-gövde, tel-yay ve baş-gövde ilişkilerinde somutlaşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Organ, tel veya baş gibi bir parçanın temas ettiği yerden ayrıldığı özel kalıplar için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir uzvun gövdeye bitişik durmayıp yanından açıldığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Temas yerinden açılma anlamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Başın gövdeden kesilip ayrıldığı özel eylem bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesip gövdeden ayırma anlamını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özel organ, yay teli ve baş kalıplarıyla sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme ve koparma eylemini daha genel nesnelere uygular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da parçanın bağlı olduğu yerden ayrılması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cisimsel örneklerle kayıtlıdır; komşu dal kesip ayırma işlemini daha genel verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal belirli örneklerde ayrılıp açılma veya koparılmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir şeyi başka şeyden ayırma ve bütünden çıkarma işlemini geniş tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir parçanın ayrılmasını konu edinir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın kullanım alanı kalıplarla sınırlıdır; komşu dal aynı işlemi daha genel bir kesme-ayırma çekirdeğinde taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal cisimsel parça-temas ilişkilerinde özel ayrılmadır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel ayrılık ve kopuş anlamıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da ayrılma çekirdeği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal özel nesne kalıplarını şart koşar; komşu dal ayrılmayı genel ve yalın biçimde anlatır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الفراق الاجتماعي أو الطلاق إلا بطريق معنى الانفصال العام.
branches.source_phrase_ar: بانت يد الناقة عن جنبها (ayn)؛ قوس بائن وهي التي بان وترها عن كبدها (ayn)؛ ضربه فأبان رأسه من جسده وفصله (sihah)؛ البائنة القوس التي بانت عن وترها كثيرا (sihah)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sağma işindeki iki kişiden birini, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından geleni belirtir. Geçici çerçeve bunu dar bir sağım terimi olarak tuttuğu için uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yalın görünse de anlam sağım alanındaki görev ve tarafla sınırlıdır; her ayrılan kişi anlamına gelmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam yalındır; tanım yine de kaynakta verilen teknik sağım rolünün dışına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Sağımda iki sağandan biri, özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen sağan kişidir; karşısında sağ taraftan gelen eş sağan bulunur.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam sağım işindeki iki kişiden bir sağandır.
Bu sağan özellikle hayvanın sol tarafından gelen kişi olarak ayırt edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar sağımda iki kişilik rol ayrımını verir; bu dal o iki kişiden birini ve özellikle sol taraftan gelen sağanı karşı tarafındaki sağanla ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda hayvanın belirli yanından gelen sağan için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım rolünü ve sol yan ayırımını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yan bilgisinin önemli olmadığı ama teknik sağım rolünün açıklanması gereken yerlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Sağım işindeki ikili rolü korur.
error_profile.loses: Sol taraftan gelme ayrıntısını açıkça vermez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal sağım yapan kişinin teknik görev adıdır.
